suite.seed_selection: Seeds 700 through 704 are a contiguous held-out range not used by the staircase suites, development examples, or persisted runs inspected before selection. Thresholds were fixed before these seeds were run. Development-only probes on the separate held-out range 600 through 604 completed 4/5 descend-main-d3 cases, 4/5 round-trip-d3-d1 cases, and 2/5 enter-mines cases.
suite.step_cap_rationale: Each case uses 1000 steps, matching the established staircase evaluation cap. The held-out probes showed successful multi-level episodes finishing within 381 steps while unsuccessful episodes reached 972 to 1000 steps, so the cap allows observed successful paths without extending hunger-limited failures.
